salesCopy.problem: You've heard about `Obsidian`. You've downloaded it. And now you're staring at a blank vault, wondering where to start. The interface looks foreign. salesCopy.agitate: Most `Obsidian` beginners fail not because the tool is too hard, but because they make the same mistakes. They over-engineer from day one with complex folder structures. They treat `Obsidian` like just another note app, missing the benefits of linking notes together. And they install dozens of plugins before mastering the basics. These mistakes lead to frustration and giving up.

Treating `Obsidian` like `Evernote` or `Google Docs` and missing what makes it different
Installing dozens of plugins before understanding core features
Building systems that work against you instead of for you

originStory.title: Why I Created This Guide
originStory.subtitle: From years of tool-hopping to finding what works
originStory.story: I tried `MediaWiki`, `TiddlyWiki`, `Evernote`, `Google Keep`, `Apple Notes`, and `Notion`. Each time I'd migrate notes, learn the system, and hit the same wall: notes trapped in proprietary formats, ideas disconnected, no sense of ownership. `Obsidian` solved this with linked notes and plain `Markdown` files I control. This guide exists so you don't spend years finding the same path.
originStory.inspirationPoint: Most beginners fail not because `Obsidian` is hard, but because they make avoidable mistakes

creatorJourney.title: From Confused User to PKM Nerd
creatorJourney.subtitle: The path that led to creating the [Obsidian Starter Kit](/product/obsidian-starter-kit)
creatorJourney.story: I'm a software developer drawn to systems and optimization. But knowledge management isn't about the fanciest system; it's about what works. When I realized `Obsidian`'s plain text files meant my knowledge would survive any tool or company, I stopped fighting my notes and started building with them.
struggles: Lost ideas locked in proprietary formats
Watched connections disappear in folder hierarchies
achievements: Created the [Obsidian Starter Kit](/product/obsidian-starter-kit) used by thousands
Published **hundreds of articles** on knowledge management
Built a vault with **10,000+** interconnected notes
Helped many beginners avoid the mistakes I made
creatorJourney.credentials: IT Solution Architect with **20+ years** experience; `Obsidian` daily user since **2020**
